[[Kyuzo]] is a [[collector]], an NPC that trades [[trophy|trophies]] for armor or weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Bukdek Byway}} (does not [[spawn]] during or after [[Winds of Change]]) 

==Dialogue==
:''"For years I have been telling the [[Celestial Ministry]] that our building practices are unsafe. The dense population...the poor living conditions...it is a recipe for disaster! And disaster, it seems, has finally struck. But I think I might be onto a cure! I noticed that [[mantid]]s do not seem to be affected by this plague. Perhaps it is coincidence, but for all of our sakes, I pray not. You know, if you are not too busy, I could really us your help collecting more mantid pinchers. If you bring me 5 Venerable Mantid Pincers, I can give you this:"''

{{collector no armor trade dialogue|Venerable Mantid Pincers}}

{{:Kyuzo/Collector armor}}

==Notes==
{{bug|Kyuzo does not spawn during or after completion of the [[Winds of Change]] quest line. If that is the case, you need to have [[Memories of Purity]] active to make him spawn.}}

==Trivia==
* Kyūzō is also the name of a samurai character in [[w:Seven Samurai|Seven Samurai]].
